intro.text: You can type every key now. Time to practise the kind of writing you do every day.
intro.tip: Read a few words ahead while you type – your fingers will follow your eyes.

steps.title: Short sentences
text: The kettle is boiling. Would you like a cup of tea? I'll bring some biscuits too.
Please remember to water the plants on Tuesday. The tomatoes need extra care.
steps.instructions: No keyboard on screen any more – you don’t need it.

steps.title: Longer sentences
text: When the rain finally stopped, the children rushed outside to splash in the puddles, laughing all the way to the park.
Although the hill looked steep, we reached the top in twenty minutes and enjoyed a wonderful view of the valley below.
steps.instructions: Keep a steady rhythm through the commas.
